summary: Ideas cannot be revised (narrowed/pivoted) or related beyond derived_from, so narrowing and merging a candidate cohort is not representable
expected: `idea revise` creating a new IdeaRevision (narrowing_or_pivot, target_customer, business_model, focused_mvp_scope, estimated_mvp_weeks, key_validation_test, change_reason, author) with a stale-revision guard, and `idea relate` for combined_with/duplicates/pivots_from with rationale; idea page shows revision history and all relations.
actual: `foundry idea revise` and `idea relate` do not exist. IdeaRevision fields beyond title/description/customer/validation-test are unreachable from the CLI; IdeaRelationKind has COMBINED_WITH/DUPLICATES/PIVOTS_FROM but only DERIVED_FROM is writable via `idea create --parent-id`.
reproduction: `python3 tools/foundry_agent.py cli idea revise --id AS01` → 'invalid choice: revise'. Read IdeaDraft and PortfolioService._create in src/startup_foundry/portfolio.py.
impact: Narrowing AS01→wedge or merging AS01+AS08 would require creating replacement ideas, orphaning scores and duplicating descriptions; the Foundry principle 'an idea can be derived, combined, narrowed, rescored, or rejected without losing the prior interpretation' is not operable from the public interface.
suggestion: Add `idea revise --input` and `idea relate --input`, carry competition links to the new revision, label assessments with the revision scored, and render revisions/relations on the idea page. Being implemented in package F02.
